content: The shadow of a figure consists of the lieux refining it; these are called lieux “de la figure”, with a warning not to confuse them with its strata.

The multiombre is formed from the shadows of the strata and is indexed by the deployment tilde F, the set of strata of F. The inclusion relation of the associated set-theoretic figure is identified with the incidence relation between strata, induced by ≤ on M or by ≪.

The author says a figure is practically never reconstructed from its shadow, but is often reconstructed from its multiombre, citing “Ateliers ensemblistes”. The final unfinished paragraph announces canonical order relations.
math_reading_decisions: The tilde is a genuine wave over the ordinary variable F. The M is a tall curved capital consistent with the supplied provisional mathcal M convention.
Both ≤ and ≪ are visually clear. No extra bar is added to the double less-than sign.
The phrase “ça revient au $\overline m$” contains a verbal barred-m abbreviation, not an equality sign. No mathematical equality or proof has been supplied editorially.
The possible plural incidences and the two de/dans alternatives are retained from ink even though an expected locative expression might favor one reading.
No definitions from another page were consulted and no proof of the reconstruction or induced-order claims was attempted. The incomplete final sentence has not been continued.
